text:
[LECC.2.2] The standard families are:

- `request.*` — the request was rejected at validation or
  dispatch, before the adapter attempted to contact the backend.
- `internal.*` — adapter or runtime bug. The failure is the
  adapter's fault, not the upstream's.
- `adapter.*` — the system the adapter fronts failed: it was
  unreachable, refused the request, throttled it or answered
  wrongly. The adapter chooses the leaf ([LECC.4.3]).

There are no other families.
